recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-3738 unless PA opens a new tracker to change the current Person model.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Patient Administration request to reinstate the Person resource for patient identity management and qualified record linking across identity domains, as an independent linker for Patient, RelatedPerson, Practitioner, and similar person-type resources rather than a generic base class.
initial_application: Commit e7291feeeed431c97f14f54a83d348baf36c163d, "Tracker #3738 - reinstated the Person resource," added person=Person to source/fhir.ini, removed Person from the removed-resources list, and added Person examples, narrative, and spreadsheet source. Later source refactors migrated the resource into the current StructureDefinition-based layout.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini lists Person as an active resource, assigns it to PA, gives it the psn abbreviation, and marks it approved. The current Person StructureDefinition and narrative define a concrete linkage resource with Person.link.target references to Patient, Practitioner, RelatedPerson, and Person, plus narrative explaining optional/advanced use and non-actor boundaries. Jira has no normalized linked issues for FHIR-3738, and targeted Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because current core source already implements and documents the reinstated Person resource in build scope.
